Co-SMOS v1.1 — Scheduled Reset (cron)

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/api/main.py, smos/core/queue_reset.py
- Frontend: frontend/index.html
- Existing: Reset Center (Задача 3, Archive Undo)
- Problem: reset can only be triggered manually.
  No scheduled reset (night / weekly / custom cron).

GOAL:
1. POST /api/queue/reset/schedules {name, cron, scope, enabled}
2. GET /api/queue/reset/schedules
3. PATCH /api/queue/reset/schedules/{id}
4. DELETE /api/queue/reset/schedules/{id}
5. Background task: check every 60s if any schedule is due, run reset.
6. Storage: .jules/reset_schedules.json
7. Audit every scheduled run: .jules/history/reset_audit.jsonl
8. Frontend: Reset Center tab "Scheduled"
   - schedule-card, schedule-enabled, schedule-name, schedule-scope,
     schedule-cron, schedule-save, schedule-delete
   - btn-add-schedule

REQUIREMENTS:
- Schedule object: {id, name, cron, scope, enabled, created_at, last_run}
- Cron: simple parser (min hour dom mon dow), no new deps
- Scope: same as reset-column (ready/running/review/blocked/completed/all)
- Background: asyncio task started on app startup
- Only operator/admin can CRUD schedules
- Audit entry: {timestamp, action: "scheduled_reset", scope, schedule_id, moved, archive_file}

TESTS:
- test_schedule_crud
- test_schedule_runs_due
- test_schedule_storage
- test_schedule_audit
- frontend contract: schedule-card, btn-add-schedule, schedule-cron

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/
- Simple cron parser (no new deps)
- Only operator/admin
- Do not weaken existing tests

TESTS: pytest tests/ + git diff --check
REPORT FORMAT: AGENTS.md §14

FINAL REPORT:
1. what already existed and was reused
2. what was added
3. what was deliberately not changed
4. tests/results
5. remaining gaps

AFTER COMPLETION: Suggest 3-5 next steps.

Co-SMOS v1.1 — Archive Export (CSV / Markdown / JSONL)

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/api/main.py, smos/core/queue_reset.py
- Frontend: frontend/index.html
- Existing: POST /api/queue/reset-column (Задача 1)
- Archive format: .jules/queue/reset-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.jsonl
  Line format:
    {
      "task_id": "...",
      "status": "...",
      "request": "...",
      "priority": N,
      "created_at": "...",
      "reset_at": "...",
      "scope": "...",
      "restored": false,
      "why": {
        "source_task": null,
        "proposal_origin": null,
        "proposed_by": null,
        "history_transitions": [...]
      }
    }
- Problem: Archive can only be read by hand (cat/grep).
  No Export in UI. No CSV/MD/JSONL download.

GOAL:
1. Add GET /api/queue/archive/export?format=csv|md|jsonl&scope=all
   - Reads all .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl files
   - Returns file with Content-Disposition: attachment
   - Filename: reset-archive-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.csv|md|jsonl
2. Frontend: buttons in view-history:
   - btn-export-csv     → "Export CSV"
   - btn-export-md      → "Export Markdown"
   - btn-export-jsonl   → "Export JSONL"
3. Show download feedback (toast / inline message)
4. Handle empty archive (no reset-*.jsonl) gracefully

REQUIREMENTS:

1. ENDPOINT
- GET /api/queue/archive/export
  Query params:
    format: "csv" | "md" | "jsonl" (required)
    scope:  "all" (default) — filter by scope field in archive lines
  Auth: operator/admin
- Response:
    - 200 with file (Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=...)
    - 404 ARCHIVE_EMPTY if no reset-*.jsonl files
    - 400 INVALID_FORMAT if format not in (csv, md, jsonl)

2. FORMATS
- CSV:
    Header: task_id,status,request,priority,created_at,reset_at,scope,restored
    One row per archive line
    Escape commas/quotes properly
- Markdown:
    # Queue Archive — Export
    Total: N tasks
    ---
    ## task-XXXX
    - Status: DEFERRED
    - Request: ...
    - Priority: N
    - Created: ...
    - Reset: ...
    - Scope: ...
    - WHY:
      - source_task: ...
      - proposed_by: ...
      - history:
        - [ts] STATUS: message
- JSONL:
    One JSON object per line (raw archive lines)

3. FRONTEND (view-history)
- Add buttons:
    id="btn-export-csv"     → "Export CSV"
    id="btn-export-md"      → "Export Markdown"
    id="btn-export-jsonl"   → "Export JSONL"
- On click:
    - Show loading state
    - Fetch GET /api/queue/archive/export?format=...
    - Trigger download (blob + <a download>)
    - Show success toast
- If 404 ARCHIVE_EMPTY:
    - Show info message: "No archive yet. Run a reset first."
- CSS: .export-buttons, .export-btn, .export-toast

4. TESTS
- test_archive_export_csv
- test_archive_export_md
- test_archive_export_jsonl
- test_archive_export_empty (404)
- test_archive_export_invalid_format (400)
- test_archive_export_requires_operator (403 for consultant)
- test_archive_export_scope_filter
- frontend contract:
    * btn-export-csv, btn-export-md, btn-export-jsonl
    * export-buttons, export-btn, export-toast

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/, .jules/queue/
  (except READING from .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl — allowed)
- Do not weaken existing tests.
- Only operator/admin can export.
- Handle empty archive gracefully.
- Do not invent new archive format — use existing reset-*.jsonl.

TESTS: pytest tests/ + git diff --check
REPORT FORMAT: AGENTS.md §14

FINAL REPORT:
1. what already existed and was reused
2. what was added (endpoint, formats, frontend buttons)
3. what was deliberately not changed
4. tests/results
5. remaining gaps

AFTER COMPLETION: Suggest 3-5 next steps.

Co-SMOS v1.1 — Archive Undo (Selected + Filter by status/date)

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/api/main.py, smos/core/queue_reset.py
- Frontend: frontend/index.html
- Existing:
    * POST /api/queue/reset-column (Задача 1)
    * GET /api/queue/archive/export?format=csv|md|jsonl (Задача 2)
- Archive format: .jules/queue/reset-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.jsonl
  Line format:
    {
      "task_id": "...",
      "status": "...",
      "request": "...",
      "priority": N,
      "created_at": "...",
      "reset_at": "...",
      "scope": "...",
      "restored": false,
      "why": {
        "source_task": null,
        "proposal_origin": null,
        "proposed_by": null,
        "history_transitions": [...]
      }
    }
- Problem: After reset, tasks are archived but cannot be restored.
  No Undo in UI. No filter by status/date.

GOAL:
1. Add POST /api/queue/archive/undo {archive_ids: [...], confirm: "UNDO"}
2. Add POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter {status, date_from, date_to, scope, search, confirm: "UNDO"}
3. Add GET /api/queue/archive (list archive entries, read-only)
4. Frontend: Reset Center panel with tabs:
    - Columns (existing reset buttons)
    - Archive (list with checkboxes)
    - Undo (filters + Undo Selected / Undo All Matched)
5. Shift+Click range selection for archive checkboxes

REQUIREMENTS:

1. GET /api/queue/archive
- Reads all .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl
- Response: {entries: [{archive_id, task_id, status, request, priority, created_at, reset_at, scope, restored}, ...]}
- archive_id = "<file>:<line_number>" (unique per entry)
- Auth: operator/admin

2. POST /api/queue/archive/undo
- Request: {archive_ids: [...], confirm: "UNDO"}
- For each archive_id:
    - Find the line in reset-*.jsonl
    - If restored == true → skip (already restored)
    - Create new Task:
        * request = entry.request
        * priority = entry.priority
        * status = "PENDING"
        * why = entry.why (preserve)
        - history_transitions = entry.why.history_transitions +
            [{timestamp: now, status: "PENDING", message: "RESTORED from <archive_id>"}]
    - Add to state.json / tasks
    - Mark archive line restored: true (rewrite .jsonl line)
- Response: {status, restored: [...], failed: [...]}

3. POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter
- Request: {status?, date_from?, date_to?, scope?, search?, confirm: "UNDO"}
- Find all archive entries matching filter:
    * status: entry.status == status
    * date_from: entry.reset_at >= date_from
    * date_to: entry.reset_at <= date_to
    * scope: entry.scope == scope
    * search: substring in entry.request or entry.task_id
- For each matching entry:
    - If restored == true → skip
    - Create new Task (same as undo)
    - Mark archive line restored: true
- Response: {status, matched: N, restored: [...], failed: [...]}

4. FRONTEND — Reset Center panel
- Section: id="view-reset-center"
- Navigation: <button data-view="reset-center">♻️ Reset Center</button>
- Tabs:
    * id="tab-columns" data-tab="columns"
    * id="tab-archive" data-tab="archive"
    * id="tab-undo"    data-tab="undo"
- Tab "Columns":
    * Keep existing reset buttons (btn-reset-ready..btn-reset-all)
- Tab "Archive":
    * Table id="archive-list"
    * Columns: checkbox, task_id, status, priority, reset_at, scope, restored
    * checkbox class="archive-select" data-archive-id="..."
    * Shift+Click range selection (JS)
- Tab "Undo":
    * Filters: undo-filter-status, undo-filter-from, undo-filter-to, undo-filter-scope, undo-filter-search
    * Shows "Matched: N tasks" (live count via POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter with dry_run)
    * Buttons:
        - id="btn-undo-selected"      → "↩️ Undo Selected"
        - id="btn-undo-all-matched"   → "↩️ Undo All Matched"
    * Confirm modal: id="undo-confirm-modal", id="undo-confirm-input" (type "UNDO")
- CSS: .reset-center-tabs, .reset-tab, .archive-list, .archive-row, .archive-select,
    .undo-filters, .undo-filter-row, .undo-btn, .undo-matched-count

5. PRESERVE WHY
- When restoring, keep entry.why in the new task
- Add history_transition entry: "RESTORED from <archive_id>"

6. TESTS
- test_archive_list_returns_entries
- test_undo_selected_creates_tasks
- test_undo_marks_restored
- test_undo_preserves_why
- test_undo_skips_already_restored
- test_undo_filter_by_status
- test_undo_filter_by_date
- test_undo_filter_by_search
- test_undo_filter_returns_matched_count
- test_undo_requires_confirm
- test_undo_requires_operator
- frontend contract:
    * view-reset-center, tab-columns, tab-archive, tab-undo
    * archive-list, archive-row, archive-select
    * undo-filter-status, undo-filter-from, undo-filter-to, undo-filter-scope, undo-filter-search
    * btn-undo-selected, btn-undo-all-matched
    * undo-confirm-modal, undo-confirm-input

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/
- Allowed: read/rewrite .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl (mark restored: true)
- Allowed: update state.json (add restored tasks)
- Do not weaken existing tests.
- Only operator/admin can undo.
- Preserve WHY from archive.
- Handle empty archive gracefully.

TESTS: pytest tests/ + git diff --check
REPORT FORMAT: AGENTS.md §14

FINAL REPORT:
1. what already existed and was reused
2. what was added (endpoints, filters, frontend)
3. what was deliberately not changed
4. tests/results
5. remaining gaps

AFTER COMPLETION: Suggest 3-5 next steps.
